feeds.title: Empty Nest Blessed
feeds.description: Our mission is to Inspire Empty Nesters to embrace all the blessings this season of life has to offer. Follow us to keep up with the latest on travel, fashion, beauty, cooking, health & fitness, generating income in the empty nest, ideas for great date nights and much more.

feeds.title: Sharing Journey
feeds.description: Sharing a Journey is a Top Tampa Life and Style Blog in which Nina shares her beauty and fashion tips Welcome to Sharing A Journey! As women of a certain age, we know that while our bodies may have different ideas, we are still having fun, enjoying life, and full of dreams. The best part is that now we actually have the tools and wisdom to make them come true. My nest is empty, and I've been exploring and reconnecting to interests, passions and friends.

feeds.title: Life in my Empty Nest
feeds.description: Welcome to Life in my Empty Nest by Victoria. I am Married to my college sweetheart for 30 years! 2 daughters Melissa (24) and Megan (28) Recently downsized and moved from Michigan to the Gulf Coast of Florida. I am Learning to embrace this new stage of life. I write about my new life in Florida and living a healthy life with Type 2 Diabetes

feeds.title: Adventures of Empty Nesters
feeds.description: This is the place to learn about what is going on in the world of Empty Nesters! My husband Craig and I have been married for 33 years and our two fabulous adult children are Alexandra, 29 and Nicholas, 25. I love traveling, cooking, restaurants, flowers, exercising, photography and reading in no particular order

feeds.title: The Empty Nest Mom
feeds.description: Welcome! Are you an empty nest mom, struggling to figure out how to flourish in this new season? I'm hoping to provide you some tools, tactics, and tips through this site. Join me and others like me to navigate these new flight patterns with confidence.

feeds.title: The Empty Nesters' Travels Blog
feeds.description: The Empty Nesters' Travels is a website that provides travel tips and destination guides for empty nesters, or couples whose children have left home. The website's mission is to inspire and empower empty nesters to embark on new adventures, create unforgettable memories, and embrace the next chapter of their lives with open arms.

feeds.title: Postcard Jar Blog
feeds.description: We're Steve and Ann Teget and we blog about extraordinary travel for everyday people. Postcard Jar travel blog has travel inspiration, ideas for destinations and travel tips. Midlife travel bloggers at their best.

feeds.title: Mama's Empty Nest
feeds.description: This Blog contains articles on how to redefine life after the kids have flown.

feeds.title: Simply Sunni
feeds.description: SimplySunni Born and raised in Florida, I am an empty nesting creative writer. Designing copy and articles is a passion I have enjoyed for years. Bringing Writing & Design Creativity to Everyday.

feeds.title: Life Of The Empty Nesters
feeds.description: Travel, freedom, and fun, that is what's next for us! We will share our travel adventures, travel tips and travel blogs, as we travel across the USA and abroad.

feeds.title: The Empty Nest
feeds.description: My blog name was born from the fact that my two wonderful, talented and handsome sons are grown and out of the house. I know many parents love when their children grow up and move out, but I hated it. Without sounding too sappy...my boys were such a complete joy to raise and be around. I seriously can count on one hand the number of times they gave me a problem.They have grown up to be each other's best friends, which my proudest achievement as a mom.

feeds.title: My Tiny Empty Nest & My Tiny House Village
feeds.description: My interest in all-things-tiny-and-old started at 12 years old when I became fascinated with a tiny abandoned farm house near my parent's home...and I've been sketching floor plans ever since. My Tiny Houses are the culmination of a life spent dreaming of a tiny reclaimed space, all my own.

feeds.title: Empty Nest Eats
feeds.description: I'm Chris. What happens when a 50-something couple finally gets their kids out of the house - and they share the same kitchen? My husband and I are starting a whole new adventure in cooking.

feeds.title: Skip to My Life
feeds.description: Looking for friends to help you through the Empty Nest? I'll pop into your email about once a week to let you encourage and challenge you.

feeds.title: Empty Nest Insider
feeds.description: I'm Julie Kemp Pick, an empty nester who began writing for a local news website. I've been married for 30 years and have two grown sons.

feeds.title: Old Bag on a Plane Blog
feeds.description: Travel, reviews and other superfluous musings for the recently empty-nested.

feeds.title: Empty Nest
feeds.description: Once I adjusted to an empty nest, I decided a blog would be the best way to connect with other empty nesters. Since then, I discovered that the world of blogging contains all sorts of delightful people from all stages in life and sharing tales of our lives has brought many of us close despite the physical distance between us.

feeds.title: Feathering My Empty Nest
feeds.description: Feathering My Empty Nest is a humorous lifestyle blog that features posts about entertaining, home decor, DIY projects, recipes and crazy personal anecdotes.

feeds.title: Linda Hanstra Blog
feeds.description: Stories of parenting, the empty nest, biking, travel, faith (Christian beliefs), support for empty-nesters and more on the blog. Linda Hanstra is a creative non-fiction writer, a cyclist, travel blogger, Jesus follower, wife to one and mom to four, who shares the joy in her journey and the light along the way.

feeds.title: Moyer Memoirs
feeds.description: This is the website of an obsessive, crazy planner and my detail-oriented life that is organized for unique experiences in life, culture and the environment around me. As an empty-nester, I am able to roam the world. I often travel with my hubby and sometimes my adult daughters. There is so much to see and so much I have not yet experienced. I write detailed hints and advice so that those who will follow in my footsteps to destinations unknown can reap the knowledge of someone who has been there and done that. Never Stop Exploring!

feeds.title: Empty House, Full Mind | Observations from the Midlife Empty Nest
feeds.description: Welcome to Empty House, Full Mind by Sharon Greenthal. She is a Freelance writer and researcher. Follow us to keep up with Observations from the midlife empty nest.

feeds.title: Almost Empty Nest Blog
feeds.description: The journey from full nest to empty nest. An Empty Nest Blog for moms with teens, college students, and beyond.
